enforcementNote: Every rule id below has exactly one implementation in schema/semantic_validate.py (RULE_IMPLS). The validator reads `severity` and `exceptions` from THIS file at runtime, and refuses to run if the id sets differ — prose and code cannot silently diverge on ids, severities or exceptions. Each rule was checked against templates/templates.json node lists when written (see `checkedAgainstTemplates`).

rules.statement: nodes[] must match the declared template's node list in order, keyed on (section, variant), honouring required/repeatable. This is what forbids gradient-band 'table-only' on home, 'feature-cards-and-table' on pricing, and site-header 'standalone' on home.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: all 3 templates pass with zero findings (adversarial controls)

rules.statement: A section with constraints.onePerPage (all 17) may appear at most once per page.
site-header variant is 'hero-overlay' if and only if the next node is hero-home (the header renders inside the home Hero wrapper, Hero.jsx:94-95); otherwise 'standalone'.
press-marquee, when present, immediately follows hero-home (it lives inside the Hero wrapper).
Exactly one hero-category section (hero-home | pricing-hero) per page, except on hero-less templates listed in exceptions.

exceptions.reason: The 404 template has no hero; not-found-block takes the hero slot (NotFound.jsx:19-45).

rules.statement: final-cta, when present, immediately precedes site-footer.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: home/pricing: final-cta -> site-footer; not-found has no final-cta (rule n/a)

rules.statement: featurette-carousel and testimonials-carousel should not be adjacent (inferred rhythm guidance: on home they are separated by clinical-board and how-riley-works).
Two marquee sections should not be adjacent, except the observed press -> family pair on home.

exceptions.reason: Observed on the real homepage (Hero.jsx PressMarquee is the last child of Hero, followed by PersonalizationMarquee at HomePage.jsx:20).

rules.statement: At most 2 infinite marquee sections per page (home has exactly 2).

If page.route is a mapped route, page.template must equal its mapped template (dead sitemap slugs -> not-found only). Routes matching templates.json excludedRoutes are rejected (not built in this snapshot). Unknown new routes are allowed.
When page.brandContext is 'other-brand', no node may use an assetRole whose generationPolicy is must-reuse-exact, must-not-fabricate or must-not-reuse-live-endpoint.
rules.checkedAgainstTemplates: every template contains at least one such role, so none can be rendered verbatim for another brand

rules.statement: For must-reuse-exact and must-not-fabricate roles, assetRef must be one of the role's registered files (assets/asset-roles.json); 'generated:' refs are only allowed for may-generate-new roles.
Every string with x-maxWords in the schema must not exceed it (whitespace word count).
In gradient-band.comparisonTable every row.marks length equals columns length.
Every node.motion carries the section's const reducedMotionFallback (belt-and-braces with the schema).
assets/asset-roles.json: every real-world-weighted role keeps its pinned generationPolicy (PINNED_POLICIES in semantic_validate.py), and the role set equals the schema assetRole enums.
